mapper.delete: delete from dwd_user_login_record where dates = #{dates} and source_id is null
mapper.select: select dulr2.id, t.* from (SELECT ll.user_id, ll.id source_id, ll.dates, ll.create_time, u.dates register_dates, u.create_time register_date, u.pkg, 'IN' country, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, u.create_time, ll.create_time) register_cohort_day, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, u.dates, ll.dates) register_day, ll.pvn version FROM ods_login_log ll INNER JOIN ods_user u on (ll.user_id = u.id) WHERE ll.dates = #{dates} and ll.id >= #{startSourceId} and ll.id <= #{endSourceId}) t left join dwd_user_login_record dulr2 on (dulr2.dates = t.dates and dulr2.pkg = t.pkg and dulr2.version = t.version and dulr2.user_id = t.user_id and dulr2.register_day = t.register_day and dulr2.register_day = t.register_day and dulr2.user_id = t.user_id and dulr2.version = t.version)

select lr.id, lr.dates, lr.user_id, lr.pkg, lr.country, lr.version, lr.register_date, lr.register_dates, lr.register_version, lr.create_time, lr.register_day, lr.register_cohort_day, lr.source_id, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Unknown') user_source from dwd_user_login_record lr left join dim_user_source dus on (lr.user_id = dus.user_id) where lr.dates = #{dates} and lr.id >= #{startId} and lr.id <= #{endId}
